item.title: Mildred Williams Boynton
item.description: Mildred Boynton was a retired Accounting Specialist for CDS and an Educator. She was a graduate of Bethune Cookman College. She loved her family and will be dearly missed. Read more: Mildred Williams Boynton

item.title: Cast iron cooking class at Fort King park this weekend
item.description: The Fort King National Historic Landmark’s historic cooking classes is set to return this weekend with a special, cast iron cooking family edition. Read more: Cast iron cooking class at Fort King park this weekend

item.title: Marcia June Burt
item.description: Marcia Burt enjoyed spending her afternoons cheering for the Red Sox and enjoying music at the Orange Blossom Opry. Her vibrant spirit and passion for her interests brought sunshine to those around her. Read more: Marcia June Burt

item.title: Officials permit Ocala man to pay off $6,250 in jail liens by volunteering at faith-based shelter
item.description: A former Marion County inmate with some of the highest civil restitution liens that officials had ever seen was granted permission to pay off the $6,250 in fees by volunteering for over 300 hours at the same faith-based recovery shelter that helped turn his life around. Read more: Officials permit Ocala man to pay off $6,250 in jail liens by volunteering at faith-based shelter

item.title: Joan Carol DePuy
item.description: Joan DePuy poured love into her relationships and always had time to lend a helping hand, demonstrating her kindness and honesty in everything she did. Read more: Joan Carol DePuy

item.title: Ocala restaurant sued over slip-and-fall in aisle
item.description: An Ocala restaurant is facing a lawsuit from a Citrus County man who claims a fall on a "hidden, dangerous condition" at the establishment over two years ago resulted in serious bodily injury. Read more: Ocala restaurant sued over slip-and-fall in aisle

item.title: Marion commissioners considering new rules for private airports, fly-in communities
item.description: Marion County commissioners will hold the first of two public hearings on Thursday to determine the future of how private airports and residential fly-in communities are approved and expanded throughout the area. Read more: Marion commissioners considering new rules for private airports, fly-in communities

item.title: Ocala driver flees on I-75 through several counties before Jeep disabled by stop sticks
item.description: An Ocala man is in custody after a high-speed, multi-agency chase that stretched across several counties on Interstate 75 last week ended when he lost control of his Jeep due to spike strips.
